newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle sales light at steady $71-trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle sales light at steady $71-trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle were trading steady in light volume near midday Wednesday, according to feedlot sources.
About 400 head had sold by late morning at $71.00 per cwt in Kansas, steady with Tuesday's active day, sources there said.
Sales on about 500 head were reported in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma areas, also at $71.00.
Most showlists were close to being current, following Tuesday's heavy sales, and those with leftover numbers reportedly had cattle that could use extra days on feed.
